label: VERIFIED
extraction: Delivery Gate quality-gate.py configuration and examples. Configuration variables in quality-gate.py: RATIONALIZE (4 patterns), LIBS (5 libraries), COMPLEX_THRESHOLD (3), DISK_WARN_GB (50), DISK_CRIT_GB (15). Learning libraries to create: memory/growth-log/ (daily entries), memory/decisions/log.md, memory/output-index.md, memory/ratings-tracker.md, memory/tooling_capabilities.md. Customize LIBS dict to match file structure. Examples: simple session (edit_count=1 < 3, not complex) -> exit 0; complex task learning captured (edit_count=5, growth-log updated today) -> exit 0; complex task no learning (edit_count=4, all 5 stale) -> BLOCKED exit 2 with stderr 'Blocked: complex task completed but no learning captured today'; low disk space (disk_free=12GB < 15GB critical) -> BLOCKED exit 2 with stderr 'Blocked: disk space at 12GB (threshold: 15GB)'. Limitations: enforces habit of touching learning libraries, not quality of what recorded. If output-index.md updated but growth-log skipped, hook passes (1 of 5 libraries touched). Mechanical gates check machine-verifiable facts; pair with self-audit for content quality.
